name: AI Visibility / GEO by DigestSEO
tagline: Track brand visibility and citations across major AI answer engines
description: Measure brand mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Compare competitors, inspect citation evidence, identify losing prompts and content gaps, and refresh visibility data through a hosted OAuth MCP endpoint. The project is open source and also supports local self-hosting.

install.notes: The hosted endpoint uses OAuth. A local npm/self-hosted BYOK installation is documented in the repository.
